'''2012 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Evan Kirkpatrick LS Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Evan Kirkpatrick]] at [[2012 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Anger, Fear, Aggression (V) (Virtual Block 4)|Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
